## Delivery limits

This is a local website delivery with a sample catalogue, illustrative commercial details and stock photography. Live inventory, approved project imagery, business contact/licensing details and CRM/email delivery have not been supplied. Enquiries stay in the private local `.data` directory. See `enquiries.md` before deployment; durable shared storage is needed for serverless or multiple-instance operation. No public deployment was performed.
